rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When interrogative hamza combines with negative lā, the question asserts the negated proposition: Pharaoh's people are not God-fearing.
rows.anchor: والاستفهام اذا دخل على النفي افاد تحقيقا

words: ألا تحبون أن يغفر الله لكم
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The same particle can gently invite or propose an action, as in the appeal to forgive.
rows.anchor: وللعرض وهو طلب بلين نحو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A different, stressed ألا is an exhortative particle, analyzed as إن الناصبة plus negative لا.
rows.anchor: حرف تحضيض مركبة من إن الناصبة ولا النافية

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: The source records opposing analyses of which form is primary: the stressed form or the light form.
rows.anchor: ثم قيل المشددة اصل والمخففة فرع قيل بالعكس

rows.speaker: ابن هشام الخضراوي
rows.claim: Ibn Hisham al-Khudrawi reports that the hamza may replace hāʾ, or hāʾ replace hamza.
rows.anchor: وقيل الهمزة بدل من الهاء وبالعكس حكاه ابن هشام الخضراوي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Exception is connected when the excluded item belongs to the same class as the excepted-from item, and disconnected when it does not.
rows.anchor: الاستثناءوينقسم إلى متصل وهوما كان المستثنى من جنس المستثنى منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A disconnected exception is understood with the sense of لكن; the cited examples illustrate this usage.
rows.anchor: وتقدر ب لكن كقوله ﴿ لست عليهم بمصيطر إلا من تولى وكفر ﴾

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fa in فإنه يسلك marks the exception after رسول as disconnected; with a connected exception, the sentence would end at رسول.
rows.anchor: ودخول الفاء في ﴿ فإنه يسلك ﴾ دليل انقطاعه ولو كان متصلا لتم الكلام عند قوله رسول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: تذكرة may be parsed as an accusative substitute for لتشقى, yielding the sense that the Quran was sent down only as a reminder.
rows.anchor: ويجوز أن تكون ﴿ تذكرة ﴾ بدلا من ﴿ لتشقى ﴾

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ابتغاء وجه ربه is an exception because seeking the Lord's face is not of the same class as favors that are repaid.
rows.anchor: فابتغاء وجه ربه ليس من جنس النعم التي تجزى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Muqni is cited for nine spellings with an added yāʾ that mark a subtle, inward malakut-specific distinction.
rows.anchor: الزائد الثالث الياء زيدت لاختصاص ملكوتى باطن وذلك فى تسعة مواضع كما قاله فى المقنع

rows.speaker: أبو العباس المراكشي
rows.claim: Al-Marrakushi says the two yāʾs distinguish القوة, power, from الأيدي, hands; divine power is the more fitting, enduring sense.
rows.anchor: قال أبو العباس المراكشى إنما كتبت ﴿ بأيد ﴾ بياءين فرقا بين الأيد الذى هو القوة وبين الأيدى جمع يد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The extra yāʾ in the two conditional death phrases marks the hidden point that the Prophet's death is certain, while the conditional consequence is not.
rows.anchor: وذلك لأن موته مقطوع والشرط لا يكون مقطوعا به ولا ما رتب على الشرط هو جواب له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The added final yāʾ in the al-Anʿām occurrence signals that these reports are accounts with a manifest, malakut aspect.
rows.anchor: وكذلك زيدت بعد الهمزة فى آخر الكلمة فى حرف واحد فى الأنعام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Writing بأيكم with two yāʾs assigns the quality of being afflicted to the opponents, while the vague wording maintains courtesy and gives them time to reflect.
rows.anchor: وكذلك / بأييكم المفتون / كتبت بياءين تخصيصا لهم بالصفة لحصول ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse puts the return of the livestock first because they are full then, making their beauty more impressive than when they leave hungry.
rows.anchor: لما كان إسراحها وهي خماص وإراحتها وهي بطان قدم الإراحة لأن الجمال بها حينئذ أفخر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mary is named first because the surrounding context is about Mary; elsewhere the son is named first.
rows.anchor: لأن السياق في ذكر مريم

words: ففهمناها سليمان وكلا آتينا حكما وعلما
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Judgment precedes knowledge despite knowledge being necessary first, because the context concerns the judgment in the dispute.
rows.anchor: فإنه قدم الحكم مع أن العلم لا بد من سبقه للحكم ولكن لما كان السياق في الحكم قدمه

rows.speaker: الزمخشري
rows.claim: Al-Zamakhshari allows حكم to mean wisdom in the verse about Joseph receiving حكم and knowledge.
rows.anchor: ويحتمل أن المراد بالحكم الحكمة وبها فسر الزمخشري قوله تعالى فى سورة يوسف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In al-Anʿām, حكيم precedes عليم because the passage concerns the legislation of rulings.
rows.anchor: فلأنه مقام تشريع الأحكام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At the opening of the Joseph passage, عليم precedes حكيم in keeping with its close, which mentions knowledge of interpreting events.
rows.anchor: وأما في أول سورة يوسف فقدم العليم على الحكيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Erasing is put before confirming because the preceding verse says every term has a record; erasure affects less, while the intensified reading of يثبت conveys continuing confirmation.
rows.anchor: ويمكن أن يقال ما يقع عليه المحو أقل مما يقع عليه غيره

words: ويمح الله الباطل ويحق الحق بكلماته
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The order of erasing before establishing truth is another instance of the same ordering.
rows.anchor: وقوله ﴿ ويمح الله الباطل ويحق الحق بكلماته ﴾

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This verse places messengers before من قبلك because its context is the messengers; another verse reverses that order.
rows.anchor: لأن السياق هنا في الرسل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: قبض comes first after the preceding promise of abundant increase, avoiding repetition of expansion and encouraging spending by answering fear of scarcity.
rows.anchor: وكان هذا بسطا فلا يناسب تلاوة البسط فقدم القبض لهذا وللترغيب في الإنفاق لأن الممتنع منه سببه خوف القلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The endings match the kind of evidence: the account of destroyed generations is heard, while the water and crops are seen.
rows.anchor: لأن سوق الماء إلى الأرض الجرز مرئى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The taunt's ending fits its opening: worship and control of wealth prepare the ideas of forbearance and sound judgment, especially in managing money.
rows.anchor: لما تقدم ذكر العبادة والتصرف فى الأموال كان ذلك تمهيدا تاما لذكر الحلم والرشد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After denying that sight perceives God, اللطيف fits because subtle things ordinarily escape sight.
rows.anchor: لما قدم نفى إدراك الأبصار له عطف على ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After saying God perceives sight, الخبير adds that His perception includes full knowledge; merely perceiving something does not make every perceiver expert in it.
rows.anchor: ليس كل من أدرك شيئا كان خبيرا بذلك الشىء

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: An omitted element was said to signal that a person praying needs no intermediary, making prayer a noblest station; outside prayer, mediation occurs.
rows.anchor: قيل حذفت للاشارة إلى إن العبد في حالة الدعاء مستغن عن الواسطة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Speech may address someone according to the addressee's belief rather than reality; the people ironically call Shuʿayb forbearing and rightly guided.
rows.anchor: وقوله ﴿ لأنت الحليم الرشيد ﴾ 4 أي بزعمك واعتقادي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to taste and the praise as mighty and noble are phrased according to the addressee's own presumed belief.
rows.anchor: وقوله ﴿ ذق إنك أنت العزيز الكريم ﴾ 3

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling the alleged partners God's partners reflects the polytheists' claim, not a divine affirmation of partnership.
rows.anchor: وقعت إضافة الشريك إلى الله سبحانه على ما كانوا يقولون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The unbelievers address the Prophet as one on whom the reminder descended and call him mad in the terms of their own belief.
rows.anchor: يا أيها الذي نزل عليه الذكر إنك لمجنون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The alternative or more is used because the people were so numerous that an observer would be unsure whether they numbered one hundred thousand or more.
rows.anchor: وارسلناه إلى قوم هم من الكثرة بحيث لو رايتموهم لشككتم وقلتم مائة الف أو يزيدون عليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wording imagines what people would say if they knew how hard their hearts were: like stones, or harder.
rows.anchor: أي انكم لو علمتم قساوة قلوبكم لقلتم انها كالحجارة أو انها فوقها في القسوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The alternative or closer reflects how people would describe the Hour's speed if they understood its imminence.
rows.anchor: ولو علمتم سرعة الساعة لعلمتم انه في سرعة الوقوع كلمح البصر أو هو اقرب عندكم

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Some include Noah's statement among expressions of the speaker's belief: he hoped his people would not in fact call him a liar.
rows.anchor: وجعل منه بعضهم قوله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The return is called easier relative to human habits; the wording does not mean that one act is easier for God than another.
rows.anchor: أي بالنسبة إلى ما يعتاده المخلوقون في إن الاعادة عندهم اهون من البداءة

rows.speaker: الإمام الرازي
rows.claim: Al-Razi explains the comparison as human perspective: restoring a complete form after its existence seems easier than first creating it.
rows.anchor: وحكى الإمام الرازي في مناقب الشافعي

words: أرأيتم إن كنت على بينة من ربي
rows.speaker: غيره
rows.claim: Treating the address marker in أرأيتم as a pronoun is defensible: mental-seeing verbs may take a connected pronoun as their object in the cited constructions.
rows.anchor: من جعل الاداة المؤكد بها الخطاب في ارايتكم ضمير لم يلزمه اعتراض

rows.speaker: الجمهور
rows.claim: The majority analyze the emphatic address element in أرأيتم as a particle, which removes the syntactic objection.
rows.anchor: وأما من جرد اداة الخطاب المؤكد بها للحرفية وهو قول الجمهور فلا كلام في ذلك

rows.speaker: سيبويه
rows.claim: Sibawayh says the kāf in أرأيتم has no syntactic case.
rows.anchor: قال سيبويه لا موضع لها

rows.speaker: السكاكي
rows.claim: Al-Sakkaki assigns the kāf in أرأيتم the accusative case.
rows.anchor: وقال السكاكي موضعها نصب

rows.speaker: الفراء
rows.claim: Al-Farraʾ assigns the kāf in أرأيتم the nominative case.
rows.anchor: وقال الفراء رفع

words: أرأيتم إن أخذ الله سمعكم وأبصاركم
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When أرأيتم means tell me, it takes a singular noun or a conditional clause; the condition is past, and its answer is understood or supplied by the question.
rows.anchor: إذا علمت هذا فلها موضعان أحدهما إن تكون بمعنى اخبرني فلا تقع إلا على اسم مفرد أو جملة شرط

rows.speaker: السيرافي
rows.claim: Al-Sirafi says the tāʾ remains singular because the kāf already marks number and address, distinguishing tell me from you saw.
rows.anchor: قال السيرافي يجوز أن يكون افرادهم للتاء استغناء بتثنية الكاف وجمعها

words: أرأيتم إن كنت على بينة من ربي
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In its second use, أرأيتم means pay attention and need not be interrogative; the expected answer is omitted here as understood.
rows.anchor: والثاني تكون فيه بمعنى انتبه كقولك ارايت زيدا فاني احبه أي انتبه له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another construction supplies an answer without a conditional clause, as in the question followed by فمن يهديه.
rows.anchor: واتى في موضع آخر بالجواب ولم يات بالشرط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: لما is analyzed as لم plus ما: it negates in the past and can extend into the future, giving an ongoing, persistent negation.
rows.anchor: أما لما فتركيب بعد تركيب كأنه قال لم وما لتوكيد معنى النفي في الماضي وتفيد الاستقبال أيضا

rows.speaker: الزمخشري
rows.claim: Al-Zamakhshari distinguishes لم ينفعه, which describes the time of regret, from لما ينفعه, which says its failure to help continues.
rows.anchor: كما قال الزمخشري إذا قلت ندم زيد ولم ينفعه الندم أي حال الندم لم ينفعه

rows.speaker: الفارسي
rows.claim: Al-Farisi says لم normally negates the present, though its use can widen to deny a past action.
rows.anchor: وقال الفارسي إذا نفي بها الفعل اختصت بنفي الحال ويجوز أن يتسع فيها

rows.speaker: الخويي
rows.claim: Al-Khuʾi says ما قام reports the state at the time of speaking, while لم يقم imaginatively repeats the report across past times.
rows.anchor: قال الخويى والفرق بين النفي بلم وما أن النفي بما كقولك ما قام زيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first wording occurs in a setting of honor and mention, while ما اتخذ الله من ولد teaches a universal denial across all times.
rows.anchor: فتأمل السر في قوله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mary uses لم after mentally reviewing every period of her own life, strengthening her denial; people cannot claim the same exhaustive knowledge of her mother's life.
rows.anchor: فان مريم كانها قالت اني تفكرت في ازمنة وجودي ومثلتها في عيني لم اك بغيا

words: ذلك أن لم يكن ربك مهلك القرى بظلم وأهلها غافلون
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With بظلم, a cause for destruction may arise over time, but divine mercy withholds punishment; the past negation describes that withholding when heedlessness accompanies it.
rows.anchor: كان سبب حسن الهلاك قائما وأما الظلم فكان يتوقع في كل زمن الهلاك

words: وما كان ربك مهلك القرى حتى يبعث في أمها رسولا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The general ما كان negation fits the absence of a realized cause at every time before a messenger is sent.
rows.anchor: وان جد الظلم لكن لم يبق سببا مع الاصلاح فبقي النفي العام بعدم تحقيق المقتضى في كل زمان

rows.speaker: الحماسي
rows.claim: Al-Hamasi uses طار for lightness and rapid walking, so the Quranic wording يطير بجناحيه rules out that lexical sense.
rows.anchor: وقيل ان الطيران يتسعمل لغة في الخفة وشدة الاسراع في المشي كقول الحماسي طاروا اليه زرافات ووحدانا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Adding بجناحيه prevents the conjunction from seeming to restrict birds to those on earth, including flightless domestic fowl; the phrase describes the bird, while the location qualifies the creature.
rows.anchor: زال هذا الوهم وعلم انه ليس بطائر مقيد انما تقيدت به الدابة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mentioning earth stresses that the place of human life, activity, and property should not be corrupted, since a place suited to reform should not become a site of corruption.
rows.anchor: قيل في ذكرها تنبيه على ان المحل الذي فيه شأنكم وتصرفكم

words: في الأرض من ولي ولا نصير
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the verse from al-Tawbah, the location phrase broadens the denial to all the earth; without it, the denial could be limited to some places.
rows.anchor: لان المراد نفي النصير عنهم في جميع الأرض فلو لم يذكر لاحتمل ان يكون ذلك خاصا ببعضها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Expressions such as saying with mouths, eating in bellies, and hearts in chests are not redundant; each added location has a different rhetorical benefit.
rows.anchor: ونحوها من المقيد إذ القول لايكون الا بالفم والاكل انما يكون في البطن

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One explanation is that بأفواههم marks a claim unsupported by proof: empty speech that does not persuade the heart.
rows.anchor: فقيل ﴿ بأفواههم ﴾ للتنبيه على انه قول لا دليل عليه

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another explanation takes القول as their doctrine: they voice it but do not hold it in their hearts because they have no evidence for it.
rows.anchor: أو المراد بالقول المذهب أي هو مذهبهم بأفواههم لابقلوبهم لانه لا حجة عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The open أن may occur in a construction that begins a clause, unlike the closed إن; the distinction also separates it from the form that can mean لعل.
rows.anchor: ولانها قد تكون بمعنى لعل كما في قوله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: إنما restricts either a predicate to its subject or a subject to its predicate, functioning as a form of exclusivity for many grammarians.
rows.anchor: لقصر الصفة على الموصوف أو الموصوف على الصفة وهي للحصر عند جماعة

rows.speaker: البيانيون
rows.claim: Rhetoricians say إنما normally addresses what the hearer already knows and accepts, while negation plus exception normally addresses what the hearer denies or does not know.
rows.anchor: وفرق البيانيون بينهما فقالوا الاصل إن يكون ما يستعمل له انما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Known truths can be cast as negation and exception when a relevant consideration makes them seem unknown; this verse illustrates that rhetorical shift.
rows.anchor: ثم انه قد ينزل المعلوم منزلة المجهول لاعتبار مناسب فيستعمل له النفي والاستثناء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The messengers' humanity is framed as a concession to the opponents' premise: they did not deny being human, but rejected the claim that only angels can be sent.
rows.anchor: والرسل ما كانوا على دفع البشرية عن انفسهم وادعاء الملائكية لكن الكفار كانوا يعتقدون إن الله لايرسل إلا الملائكة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hypocrites treat an unknown and false claim of being reformers as obvious by using إنما; the emphatic response answers their self-presentation.
rows.anchor: فإن كونهم مصلحين منتف فهو مجهول بمعنى انه لم يعلم بينهم صلاح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Abi Shayba, Abu Ubayd, al-Nasaʾi, and others compiled works on Quranic virtues; sound reports exist in general and for some surahs specifically.
rows.anchor: وقد صنف فيه أبو بكر بن أبى شيبة وأبو عبيد القاسم بن سلام والنسائى وغيرهم وقد صح فيه أحاديث

rows.speaker: ابن الصلاح
rows.claim: Ibn al-Salah calls the report attributed to Ubayy on the virtue of every surah fabricated and says al-Wahidi and exegetes who included it erred.
rows.anchor: قال ابن الصلاح ولقد أخطأ الواحدى المفسر ومن ذكره من المفسرين فى إيداعه تفاسيرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author adds al-Thaʿlabi to those who included the report, but says their cited chain lessens blame; al-Zamakhshari's unchained, categorical citation is worse.
rows.anchor: قلت وكذلك الثعلبى لكنهم ذكروه بإسناد فاللوم عليهم يقل بخلاف من ذكره بلا إسناد وجزم به كالزمخشرى

rows.speaker: نوح بن أبي مريم
rows.claim: Nuh ibn Abi Maryam confessed to fabricating the surah-by-surah reports because people had turned from the Quran to jurisprudence and campaign narratives.
rows.anchor: وعن نوح بن أبى مريم أنه قيل له من أين لك عن عكرمة عن ابن عباس فى فضائل القرآن سورة سورة

rows.speaker: الزمخشري
rows.claim: Most commentators put surah virtues at the beginning to encourage readers; al-Zamakhshari puts them at the end because they are attributes, and attributes follow their subject.
rows.anchor: قال لأنها صفات لها والصفة تستدعى تقديم الموصوف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reports praise learning and teaching the Quran, being occupied by it, its superiority over other speech, and drawing near to God through it.
rows.anchor: وقد روى البخارى رحمه الله حديث خيركم من تعلم القرآن وعلمه وروى أصحاب السنن فى حديث إلهى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reports say Quran people are God's elect, that God raises and lowers people by the Book, and that the most Quran-learned were placed first among Uhud's dead in the grave.
rows.anchor: وروى أحمد من حديث أنس رضى الله عنه أهل القرآن هم أهل الله وخاصته وروى مسلم من حديث عمر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Tabari gathered scattered tafsir reports and brought distant interpretations together; Ibn Abi Hatim did likewise, while later compilers also produced careful work.
rows.anchor: ثم ان محمد بن جرير الطبري جمع على الناس اشتات التفاسير وقرب البعيد وكذلك عبد الرحمن بن أبي حاتم الرازي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Different wording among exegetes often reflects complementary senses or different emphases, not disagreement; their statements commonly converge on one meaning.
rows.anchor: ولا يفهم من اختلاف العبارات اختلاف المرادات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If distinct interpretations can be reconciled, combine them; if not, prefer the later report from one interpreter when equally sound, otherwise prefer the sounder report.
rows.anchor: فأما اذا لم يمكن الجمع فالمتأخر من القولين عن الشخص الواحد مقدم عنه ان استويا في الصحة وإلا فالصحيح المقدم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An exegete's illustrative application of a verse should not be mistaken for restricting the verse to that example; the author mentions a rebuke over al-Shadhili's application.
rows.anchor: ولقد بلغني عن شخص انه انكر على الشيخ أبي الحسن الشاذلي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because the Quran came in clear Arabic, several authorities, including Ahmad, recognize language as a basis for interpretation.
rows.anchor: الثالث الأخذ بمطلق اللغة فإن القرآن نزل

rows.speaker: أحمد بن حنبل
rows.claim: Al-Fadl ibn Ziyad reports that Ahmad disapproved when a man used a line of poetry to explain the Quran; some therefore report two positions from Ahmad on linguistic tafsir.
rows.anchor: لكن نقل الفضل بن زياد عنه وقد سئل عن القرآن تمثل له رجل ببيت من الشعر فقال ما يعجبني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disapproval can be read as targeting remote interpretations weakly supported by rare Arabic, especially poetry, when the apparent sense points elsewhere.
rows.anchor: ولهذا قال بعضهم في جواز تفسير القرآن بمعقتضى اللغة

rows.speaker: المشهور
rows.claim: The well-known view treats ellipsis as metaphor.
rows.anchor: المشهور أن الحذف مجاز وحكى إمام الحرمين في التلخيص عن بعضهم

rows.speaker: إمام الحرمين
rows.claim: Some, as reported by the Imam of the Two Sanctuaries, deny that ellipsis is metaphor because no word is used outside its proper place.
rows.anchor: أن الحذف ليس بمجاز إذ هو استعمال اللفظ في غير موضعه والحذف ليس كذلك

rows.speaker: ابن عطية
rows.claim: Ibn Atiyya calls omission of a genitive the very essence, or most of, metaphor, in agreement with Sibawayh and other theorists; he adds that not all ellipsis is metaphor.
rows.anchor: وقال ابن عطية في تفسير سورة يوسف وحذف المضاف هو عين المجاز أو معظمه

rows.speaker: الزبخاني
rows.claim: Al-Zabakhani says omission is metaphor only if it changes the grammatical ruling; omitting a predicate in زيد منطلق وعمرو does not.
rows.anchor: إنما يكون مجازا إذا تغير بسببه حكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author distinguishes senses of metaphor: an omitted word is not used outside its proper place, but ellipsis can count as metaphor if metaphor means attributing an act to other than its agent.
rows.anchor: والتحقيق أنه إن أريد بالمجاز استعمال اللفظ في غير موضعه فالمحذوف ليس كذلك لعدم استعماله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The explicit pronoun can serve solely to magnify the speaker.
rows.anchor: وقد يكون لمجرد التعظيم كقوله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pronoun can add exclusivity along with magnification: God is uniquely one in oneness.
rows.anchor: وقد يفيد معه الانفراد نحو قوله تعالى

rows.speaker: جماعة من النحاة
rows.claim: Many grammarians parse هو as a pronoun of affair, with الله as a second subject and أحد its predicate; the clause explains the pronoun and needs no antecedent.
rows.anchor: قال جماعة من النحاة هو ضمير الشأن والله مبتدأ ثان وأحد خبر المبتدأ الثاني

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: An alternative says هو refers to God, because people had asked the Prophet to describe his Lord.
rows.anchor: وقيل هو كناية عن الله لانهم سالوه ان يصف ربه فنزلت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pronoun of affair may be feminine when a feminine term appears; here the following clause is the predicate of إن.
rows.anchor: ويجوز تأنيثه اذا كان في الكلام مؤنث كقوله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the cited reading, أن يعلمه is the subject and آية the predicate; the pronoun is a pronoun of affair and is feminine because آية occurs in the sentence.
rows.anchor: بقراءة الياء وأن يعلمه بمتدأ وآية الخبر والهاء ضمير القصة وأنث لوجود آية في الكلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A connected subject pronoun is conventionally reinforced by an independent pronoun when coordinated with a noun.
rows.anchor: الثامن تأكيد الضمير ويجب ان يؤكد المتصل بالمنفصل اذا عطف عليه

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Some say reinforcement is unnecessary if a separator stands between the pronoun and the coordinated noun; the author objects that لا follows, rather than precedes, the conjunction.
rows.anchor: وقيل لايجب التأكيد بل يشترط الفاصل بينهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author rejects ما أشركنا ولا آباؤنا as proof of a separator rule: a replacement for reinforcement must precede the conjunction, as in فاستقم كما أمرت ومن تاب معك.
rows.anchor: وهذا لاحجة فيه لانها دخلت بعد واو العطف والذي يقوم مقام التاكيد انما ياتي قبل واو العطف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The magicians reinforce their own subject pronoun but not Moses's, suggesting they wanted to cast first so their great magic would dominate the audience's impression.
rows.anchor: فأكد السحر ضمير انفسهم في الالقاء دون ضمير موسى حيث لم يقولوا إما ان تلقي انت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They initially offered Moses the first turn as a courtesy customary among scholars and craftsmen dealing with peers.
rows.anchor: وانما ابتدءوا بموسى فعرضوا عليه البداءة بالالقاء على عادة العلماء والصناع في تادبهم مع قرنائهم
